message: Rob, if I can find an open long weekend in the fall, I might have to come up and see this Oktoberfest for myself. Of course, doing so would necessitate getting PFC Nestor involved, and possibly even tracking down Sergeant Johnson, just to make it feel like a real reunion. You drink out of two bottles at once, Ted'll shotgun, I'll talk like a wookiee, and SSG J will laugh at it all. Sound good?
